# Vendored BB Plugin SDK 0.4.1

This directory contains the generated runtime and TypeScript declarations for `@bb/plugin-sdk` 0.4.1.

It is used only for standalone development, typechecking, and tests because the SDK is not currently published to npm. BB supplies the SDK when the plugin runs, and Git-source installation omits this file-based development dependency.

Upstream source: <https://github.com/get-bb/bb/tree/main/packages/plugin-sdk>
